write_up: Your resume points to family services casework, from intake at Lakeview Community Center to your current role at Cuyahoga Family Partners. It’s common for resumes in this field to list core duties this way, but that makes it tough to stand out: a recruiter can see the work you handle, not how much of it or what your assessments and coordination involve.

The Lakeview line about screening walk-in clients works well because it names the people you served and the kinds of assistance they needed. Your Ohio LMSW and master’s degree also sit in clear places, and your work history is easy to follow.

Let’s start with your current caseload. Add its typical size if you can, then give the assessments, service coordination, and court work a little more substance. You can describe the work without including identifying family details.
